skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Describe key concepts in business analysis including business analyst roles, core conceptual models, and stakeholder engagement.
Apply techniques for eliciting and collaborating with stakeholders to define requirements, manage requirement lifecycles, and evaluate solutions.
Analyze and define solutions based on functional and non-functional requirements, design specifications, and solution evaluation.
Demonstrate problem-solving skills related to business analysis tasks.
Collaborate effectively in group settings to complete assignments and projects.
Engage in self-directed learning to acquire new knowledge and skills in business analysis.
Develop critical thinking abilities to analyze complex business scenarios.
Present findings and solutions effectively using appropriate communication methods.
Manage project timelines, deliverables, and team coordination for business analysis projects.
Conduct strategic analysis to assess current state, future state, risks, and change strategies.
Model and specify functional and non-functional requirements using appropriate tools and techniques.
Evaluate potential solutions based on their value and impact on business operations.
